text_block_list.text:
The prestigious title of 'Umamusume of the 
Year.' This time, it was awarded to Narita 
Brian.

Past award recipients also attend the 
ceremony. Talking with seasoned veterans 
seems like it would be a great experience. 
However, it might still be too early... 
perhaps.

Should she attend in search of encounters 
with strong rivals, or not? This was an 
important choice that would shape her 
future.
choice_data_list:
Seeking battle with powerful rivals, I'll 
'Attend'

It's not time for that yet, so "Decline to 
attend"

text_block_list.text:
—She decided to attend. Alongside Trainer, 
Narita Brian heads toward the stage 
crowded with powerhouse rivals...!

—She decided to sit it out. She is still 
just an ordinary runner among many. For 
now, she should simply re-examine her 
running... and her true strength.
